2609.15182.title: VisInteract: Towards Dynamic Interactive Text-to-Visualization under Imperfect Queries
2609.15182.paper_summary: Real-world visualization requests are routinely ambiguous, incomplete, or factually incorrect, yet existing Text-to-Visualization (Text-to-Vis) systems assume well-specified inputs and produce charts in a single pass. When queries are imperfect, a system must \emph{interact} with the user to recover the true intent, but no benchmark or method supports this dynamic process. We introduce \textbf{VisInteract}, a new paradigm that reframes Text-to-Vis as interaction-driven intent recovery, and \textbf{VisInteract-Bench}, to our knowledge, that is the first benchmark for dynamic interactive Text-to-Vis, featuring controlled imperfection injection, a leakage-controlled User Agent for realistic multi-turn feedback, and dual-perspective (code and chart) automated evaluation. On the algorithmic side, we propose \textbf{Vis-MCTS}, a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) enhanced method, introducing improvements over classical MCTS, that \emph{Progressive Widening} to tame the unbounded tool-argument space in tree search, \emph{cross-rollout information sharing} so clarifications and critiques benefit the entire search tree, and \emph{Dimension-Aware Reward Decomposition} that routes scalar user feedback along data-fidelity, visual-design, and intent-alignment dimensions to resolve credit assignment across heterogeneous actions. Extensive Experiments across two LLM backbones show that Vis-MCTS consistently outperforms all Text-to-Vis baselines, improving end-to-end task success by $13.40\%$--$16.27\%$ over the strongest interactive baseline and by more than $5\times$ over non-interactive ones.
2609.15182.paper_summary_zh: 現實世界的視覺化請求通常是模糊、不完整或事實上不正確的，但現有的文本到視覺化（Text-to-Vis）系統假設輸入是明確的，並且在單次過程中生成圖表。當查詢不完美時，系統必須與用戶進行\emph{互動}以恢復真正的意圖，但目前沒有基準或方法支持這一動態過程。我們介紹\textbf{VisInteract}，這是一種將文本到視覺化重新框架為以互動驅動的意圖恢復的新範式，以及\textbf{VisInteract-Bench}，據我們所知，這是首個針對動態互動文本到視覺化的基準，具備控制不完美注入、針對現實多輪反饋的泄漏控制用戶代理，以及雙視角（代碼和圖表）自動評估。在算法方面，我們提出\textbf{Vis-MCTS}，這是一種增強的蒙特卡羅樹搜索（MCTS）方法，對經典MCTS進行改進，引入\emph{漸進擴展}以馴服樹搜索中無界的工具參數空間，\emph{交叉回滾信息共享}使得澄清和批評能夠惠及整個搜索樹，以及\emph{維度感知獎勵分解}，將標量用戶反饋沿數據保真度、視覺設計和意圖對齊維度路由，以解決異質行動之間的信任分配。在兩個大型語言模型（LLM）骨幹上的廣泛實驗顯示，Vis-MCTS始終超越所有文本到視覺化的基準，將端到端任務成功率提高了$13.40\%$--$16.27\%$，超過最強互動基準的表現，並且比非互動基準提高了超過$5\times$。
